original_test_intent: Verify the complete approved xGMI topology between OAM endpoints matches the source table with correct link type, 16 GT/s speed and x16 width.
original_method: Agent runs the exact vendor-approved AMDXIO link-status command, captures the full table and compares every expected source/destination/link tuple and status.
manual_activity: User supplies/approves AMDXIO package and authoritative OAM topology; agent runs read-only collection and user resolves discrepancies.
required_inputs: Vendor-approved AMDXIO binary/version/checksum and install method
Complete expected OAM/BDF endpoint and link-index/type matrix
Expected 16GT/s x16 values and allowable states
Secure access, baseline logs and protected evidence storage
safety_requirements: Verify binary provenance and supported read-only syntax
Preserve complete output and exit status
Require every expected entry and flag extras
Stop on missing/extra/downshifted/error link, tool/driver mismatch, thermal/power/kernel/BMC issue
Do not reset links, load unapproved driver, update firmware or clear logs
agent_execution_scope: Parse/compare every topology entry and logs
Do not substitute alternate syntax, mutate links/firmware, accept partial output or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Review full matrix and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its `-i Src(S:B:D.F)` syntax is not the literal xGMI link-status command and does not guarantee enumeration of the complete OAM topology.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run `./amdxio -xgmi -linkstatus` from the pinned tool and compare every returned entry against the full expected endpoint/link/type/16GT/s/x16 matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exact AMDXIO xGMI command, full source topology/values and source 5/5 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Normalize the full table into stable endpoint/link keys and report missing, extra, mismatched type, speed or width with raw evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic full-table comparison without changing the read-only diagnostic.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No subset or aggregate count replaces the source's explicit topology.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: AMDXIO output format and endpoint numbering may be version/platform specific.

project_override_considerations: Only the approved AMDXIO build and project topology may define endpoint identity; alternate `-i` output is not equivalent unless formally documented.
expected_evidence: Exact command, exit status and complete raw table

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and detailed Criteria consistently define exact xGMI topology verification; package/topology inputs are prerequisites.

blocked_analysis.analysis: AMDXIO package and authoritative topology are supplyable inputs; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Replaces a non-equivalent partial query with a complete, versioned, per-link topology comparison and secure evidence handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: A fabric can retain the expected number of links while one endpoint is cross-wired, uses the wrong lane group or downshifts. Only tuple-level comparison of both directions/endpoints, link type, speed and width against the authoritative table can detect those faults; accepting partial output creates a false pass.
